$comment: C23 6.6 + 6.3.1.2 + 6.3.1.4 ([[D-C-FLOAT-CAST-DOES-NOT-FOLD-IN-A-CONSTANT-EXPRESSION]]): a cast of a floating constant to an integer type is an integer constant expression and folds in every ICE position — array bound, enumerator, bit-field width, static assertion, case label and index designator — plus the reverse direction, a cast whose target is a float. Every one of these was REFUSED by DSS before this example existed. The EXIT CODE is the instrument, not the assertions: the array bound, the bit-field width and the designated slot are all built from the folded casts, and each remaining fold is written into a guard line that cancels to zero, so a fold with the wrong VALUE exits with a number other than 42 instead of compiling quietly. ✔MEASURED: gcc 13.3.0, clang 18.1.3, mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 and MSVC 19.51 all accept this file, and gcc and mingw each run it to 42.
